title: 不同路径
statement: 机器人位于 m × n 网格的左上角，每步只能向右或向下移动一格，问到达右下角共有多少条不同的路径。

en.title: Unique Paths
en.statement: A robot is at the top-left corner of an m × n grid and can only move one cell right or down at each step. How many distinct paths lead to the bottom-right corner?
constraints: The answer is guaranteed not to exceed 2 × 10^9

complexity.time: O(m · n) (local training target); O(min(m, n)) with the binomial formula
complexity.notes: The answer is the binomial coefficient C(m + n - 2, m - 1). Computing it by multiplying term by term and then dividing exactly needs 64-bit intermediates. Because the answer is capped at 2 × 10^9, m = n = 100 never occurs; the largest local tests are grids such as m = 100, n = 7 and m = 18, n = 17 whose answers are close to the cap.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: first line integer m; second line integer n. stdout: one integer, the number of distinct paths.

complexity.time: O(m · n)（本地训练目标）；组合数公式 O(min(m, n))
complexity.space: O(min(m, n)) 额外空间（滚动数组）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: 答案为组合数 C(m + n - 2, m - 1)。用组合数逐项相乘再整除时需 64 位中间值。由于答案上限 2 × 10^9，m = n = 100 不会出现；本地最大测试为 m = 100, n = 7 与 m = 18, n = 17 等答案接近上限的网格。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行整数 m；第二行整数 n。stdout：一个整数，不同路径数。
